predecessors.name: Timurid Empire
predecessors.text: Kabul and Ghazni, 'A third son, Ulugh Beg II, became ruler of Kabul and Ghazni' (Abu Sa'id page); Cliopatria's outline of 1475 (116,849 km2, 64 cells)

successors.name: Timurid Empire
successors.text: Kabul, taken by Babur in October 1504 ('Emir of Kabul' October 1504 - 21 April 1526)

ledger.x: 1469: Abu Sa'id is executed ('Yadgar Muhammad had Abu Sa'id executed on 5 February 1469') and 'What remained of the empire was divided among various princes': 'A third son, Ulugh Beg II, became ruler of Kabul and Ghazni.'
1501/1502: Ulugh Beg II dies and Mukim Arghun takes Kabul.
October 1504: Babur takes Kabul and the principality ends.

wars.name: Babur's conquest of Kabul
wars.outcome: Babur crossed the Hindu Kush in October 1504 and captured Kabul; the Arghun chieftains retreated to Kandahar, which Babur annexed from them in 1522.

certainty.note: Mountain principality with no boundary on any page opened; the shape is Cliopatria's outline.
